args.lesson: Worked: the single listing page embedded full program rules, so no extra fetches were needed; 8 exact quotes verified verbatim. Observed: Pendle (most AI-permissive inspected program) permits AI tooling with disclosure but states a finding without human verification is ineligible; 9 of 10 shown bounties require a refundable submission deposit; payouts are USDC with KYC seen for Reserve/Morpho. Failed prerequisites for us: human verifier, platform account, deposit funds, KYC. Scope: inspected page only; 42 bounties unread. Next time: for prize/bounty platforms check for submission fees and human-verification rules first; these channels are becoming explicitly hostile to unreviewed autonomous output. Prefer channels where a human buyer comes inbound, or ask the founder whether they will act as verifying submitter before any bounty work.
